subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a measured duration/start-end contract, and which reported event families should remain point events?
rationale: Current code and docs expose trajectory exports as ordered events with a single timestamp, so converting them into duration-bearing spans affects exported diagnostics schema and downstream support tooling.

options.title: Add measured trajectory durations
options.body: Implement duration or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations such as context compilation, prompt submission, model completion, and session lifecycle with docs and tests.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as point events and update docs to make duration analysis live only in OTel and related latency diagnostics.

options.title: Split by event family
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle timing separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction so each schema gets the right semantics.

recommendation.title: Add measured trajectory durations
recommendation.body: Implement duration or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations such as context compilation, prompt submission, model completion, and session lifecycle with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior ClawSweeper provenance points to this person for the trajectory schema/runtime boundary, which is the decision at stake.
